verified: PrismML's site carries a release post titled "Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B," and commenters say they have actually run the weights locally — one reports 22.3 tokens/s generation and 222.9 tokens/s prompt processing on a Mac Mini M5 Pro (24GB RAM) using a Q2 GGUF, with a 128k context fitting in memory. Third-party comparison pages list an earlier "Ternary Bonsai 2 27B" with a mathematics category score of 45.5/100, ranking it #73 of 125 models in that category.
unconfirmed: The post's own text was not available to this briefing, so parameter count claims, license, file sizes, pricing, and download links rest on the title and commenters rather than a primary technical document. The headline performance claims come from Hacker News anecdotes with no posted methodology — the asserted SWE-bench Verified parity with Opus 4.6 (a commenter's own hedge: "unless I'm totally mistaken") and the reported ~30 tokens/s via Unsloth Studio have not been independently measured, and no one has shown whether ternary weights get hardware acceleration outside FPGAs. The sources also conflict on naming and deployment: commenters discuss "2.5" as a local GGUF, while the aggregator pages describe a "2" model as a hosted production API model dated September 2026 — the briefing cannot reconcile whether these are the same lineage.

verified: Hacker News 上关于 PrismML 的 Bonsai 2.5 27B 的讨论中，多位评论者称已在本机运行该模型的三值量化版本（Q2 GGUF）：一人在 Mac Mini M5 Pro（24GB 内存、512GB SSD）上测得生成速度约 22.3 tok/s、首字延迟约 2.12 秒、提示处理约 222.9 tok/s，并表示可轻松装下 128k 上下文；另一人通过 Unsloth Studio 在 MacBook 上测得约 300 tok/s 预填充、30 tok/s 生成，并称其智能体调用“稳定”。以上均为用户自测数据，不是厂商基准。
unconfirmed: PrismML 官方给出的参数量、量化方案、基准分数、许可证与发布范围在可得材料中均未出现；“在 SWE-bench Verified 上与 Opus 4.6 相当”仅是一位评论者的推测，他本人也质疑其中有多少是“刷榜”、多少是基准本身变化；benchlm.ai 与 anotherwrapper.com 的第三方对比页把该模型与 Claude Opus 4.6 并列，但其中一页标注日期早于本次发布，不能视为独立验证。其在真实智能体编码任务中的表现，以及三值权重除 FPGA 外是否存在硬件加速，同样未得到证实。
